The Craft takes an editorial approach to the magical portfolio — less interactive ceremony, more cinema. A large atmospheric focal image dominates the entry point, setting a mood before a single word is read, and the restrained typography throughout preserves that cinematic quality. This is a portfolio that communicates through atmosphere and tone as much as through content.

## Theme Overview

The Craft is designed around the principles of editorial photography and dark cinematic art direction. The atmospheric focal image at the top of the page functions like a magazine cover or film still — it establishes a world before the content begins. Typography throughout is deliberately restrained: careful sizing, measured spacing, and dark tones that allow the imagery to remain dominant. The occult mood is achieved through atmosphere and composition rather than overt iconography, giving the theme a more sophisticated, editorial register.

## Design Highlights

- Full-bleed atmospheric focal image that establishes mood and cinematic identity from the first moment
- Restrained typographic approach with careful sizing and measured spacing throughout
- Occult mood conveyed through atmosphere and composition rather than explicit magical iconography
- Dark editorial color palette that supports the cinematic quality of the imagery
- Layout pacing that feels deliberate and curated, like a well-designed print publication

## Who This Theme Suits

The Craft is an excellent fit for developers and creative technologists who have a strong visual sensibility and want their portfolio to feel like a curated experience rather than an information page. It works particularly well for those whose work spans code and design, or who want to signal aesthetic taste alongside technical skill.

<Tip>The focal image is the most important customization point in The Craft. Choose a photo or illustration that genuinely represents your aesthetic identity — the entire mood of the portfolio radiates from that single visual choice.</Tip>
